svg.title: Allen's 13 relations as a bar grid, Freksa's neighbourhood lattice with computed real examples
svg.text: Visual form from „Von Allen zu Freksa“ (Florian's reference article, 2026-09-16) — every FID/year real
Allen's 13 relations as a bar grid
Bar shape schematic, as in the original (Abb. 1) — petrol = X (fixed), ocher = Y — read as ‘X <r> Y’; FID/name/culture are real
Freksa's neighbourhood lattice — seven computed examples
Every real dating carries a real margin (±10 to ±200 years,
see 06-uncertainty-dating). For each of the seven pairs below, which of
the 13 relations remain possible within that margin was computed, not
guessed — and whether that set is connected in the lattice.
All seven result sets are connected (Freksa's neighbourhood theorem,
not chosen to be) — including the ‘equals’ pair, top right: the full set
of all 13 is trivially connected too, it just stops saying anything.
